name: Zoom - Adminstrator Activity - New
description: The Zoom - Administrator Activity dashboard provides insights into Administrative trends, user account activities, and user account trends.
title: Zoom - Adminstrator Activity - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "event" ("account.created" or "account.disassociated" or "account.settings_updated" or "account.updated" or "user.settings_updated" or "user.updated" or "user.created" or "user.activated" or "user.deleted" or "user.deactivated" or "user.disassociated" or "app_deauthorized")
| json "event", "payload.operator", "payload.account_id", "payload.time_stamp" as event, admin, account_id, timestamp nodrop
| where event in ("account.created", "account.disassociated","account.settings_updated","account.updated", "user.settings_updated", "user.updated", "user.created", "user.activated", "user.deleted", "user.deactivated", "user.disassociated", "app_deauthorized")
| timeslice 1h
|where if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{admin}}" = "*", true, admin matches "{{admin}}")
|count by event, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column event

_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "account.created"
| json "event", "payload.operator", "payload.account_id", "payload.object.owner_email" as event, admin, account_id, owner_email
| where event = "account.created"
|where if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{admin}}" = "*", true, admin matches "{{admin}}")
|count as count by admin, account_id, owner_email
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "user.updated"
| json "event", "payload.account_id", "payload.operator","payload.object", "payload.old_object", "payload.time_stamp" as event, account_id, admin, new_object, old_object, update_timestamp
| where event = "user.updated"
| sort by update_timestamp
|where if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{admin}}" = "*", true, admin matches "{{admin}}")
|count by update_timestamp, admin, old_object, new_object
| replace(new_object, /\{|\}/, "") as new_object
| replace(new_object, /\:/, " => ") as new_object
| replace(new_object, /,/, "\n") as new_object
| replace(old_object, /\{|\}/, "") as old_object
| replace(old_object, /\:/, " => ") as old_object
| replace(old_object, /,/, "\n") as old_object
| formatDate(fromMillis(update_timestamp),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as update_timestamp
| fields -_count
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "account.disassociated"
| json "event", "payload.operator", "payload.account_id", "payload.object.owner_email" as event, admin, account_id, owner_email
| where event = "account.disassociated"
|where if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{admin}}" = "*", true, admin matches "{{admin}}")
|count as count by admin, account_id, owner_email
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  ("user.deleted" or "user.disassociated" or "user.deactivated")
| json "event", "payload.account_id", "payload.operator","payload.object.email", "payload.object.type" as event, account_id, admin, user_email, user_type
| where event in ("user.deleted", "user.disassociated", "user.deactivated")
| if (user_type == 1, "Basic", if(user_type == 2, "Licensed", if(user_type == 3, "On-prem", "Unknown"))) as user_type
|where if ("{{event}}" = "*", true, event matches "{{event}}") AND if ("{{admin}}" = "*", true, admin matches "{{admin}}") AND if ("{{user_email}}" = "*", true, user_email matches "{{user_email}}")
|count by _receiptTime, event, admin, user_email, user_type
| sort by _receiptTime
| formatDate(_receiptTime,"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as event_time
| fields -_receiptTime, _count
| fields event_time, event, admin, user_email, user_type
| limit 20

_sourceCategory = Labs/Zoom  "app_deauthorized"
| json "event", "payload.account_id", "payload.client_id", "payload.deauthorization_time" as event, account_id, app_client_id, deauthorization_time
